results.name: cloakbrowser: socks5 proxy (rfc1929 auth)
results.detail: SOCKS proxy authentication is not supported without exposing the credentials in the process table: Chromium can only authenticate a SOCKS proxy through the URL of the --proxy-server flag. Use an HTTP proxy with credentials, or a local relay (see docs/refactor-4-9-camoufox-production-readiness.md).

results.name: cloakbrowser: HTTPS_PROXY env behaviour (informational)

results.name: cloakbrowser: proxy credentials do not leak

results.name: cloakbrowser: EXPERIMENT socks5 auth with inline credentials
results.detail: works, but the password is in the argv of 3 processes — not usable in production

results.name: production: proxy credentials stay out of the browser process
results.detail: the production launch path authenticates the proxy without exposing the credentials
